render_resolution: from_create_camera_model; record actual width and height per config.json
encoded_video_resolution: probe after encoding; must equal render_resolution
projection_proxy_validity: center/current UV in actual render bounds; center/current camera depth > 0; finite displacement
output_policy: new non-empty output directories are rejected unless explicit --allow-overwrite
notes: Projection displacement is a Gaussian-center proxy, not optical flow or a fixed camera angle. Change only max_disparity in the formal motion matrix.
